ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle DEF$, with points B, E, C, F lying on the same straight line. If $BC=7$ and $EC=4$, then what is the length of $CF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle DEF$,\\
hence $BC = EF$.\\
Since points B, E, C, and F are on the same line, and $BC = 7$, $EC = 4$,\\
therefore $CF = EF - EC = BC - EC = 7 - 4 = \boxed{3}$.
